description: Send the same text to a list of phone numbers (up to 500), each as its own one-to-one message from your paired phone's own number. Only use this when the user has asked to text a list of people, and confirm the list and wording first: every recipient gets a real text. The message can be personalized from each recipient's contact record with {{name}}, {{first_name}}, {{last_name}}, {{full_name}}, {{company}}, {{city}} or {{state}}, and {{first_name|there}} gives a fallback when the field is empty. {{name}} is the name set by save_contact; first_name and last_name are only filled for contacts imported with those fields. Broadcasts send now and cannot be scheduled. Returns sent and failed counts and a message_id per recipient.

device_id.description: Optional id of the phone to send every message from. If omitted, the first online phone is used.

media_url.description: Optional public URL of an image to attach to every message (MMS).

message.description: The text to send, up to 1600 characters. May contain the personalization tokens above.

phones.description: Recipient phone numbers, up to 500. Use E.164 format (e.g. +15551234567). A number without a country code is read in the country of the phone's SIM. To text everyone with a tag, get their numbers from list_contacts first.

round_robin.description: Optional. Spread the messages across all of your online phones instead of sending them all from one. Ignored when device_id is set.

name: send_broadcast
title: Send one text to many people
